svg.title: How NeoPilot flies your idea
svg.desc: A flight path from your idea through Preparation, Requirements, Briefing, Specification, Plan, Development, Code review and Acceptance to a finished project, with gates G1–G4, a repair loop and an optional polish loop; underneath, the contract and memory files, the three dials and the five rules that never bend.

g.text: decide what to build → build it → prove it was built
only you can drop a requirement
THREE DIALS · set once, switch anytime
• every gate runs in every mode
